{{Main|2020 WTA Tour}}

The WTA Premier Mandatory and Premier 5 tournaments, which are part of the [[WTA Premier tournaments]], make up the elite tour for professional women's [[tennis]] organised by the [[Women's Tennis Association|WTA]] called the [[WTA Tour]]. There are four Premier Mandatory tournaments: Indian Wells, Miami, Madrid and Beijing and five Premier 5 tournaments: Doha, Rome, Canada, Cincinnati and Wuhan.<ref>{{Cite web |title=2020 Tournaments {{!}} WTA Official |url=https://www.wtatennis.com/tournaments/2020 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20220920193141/https://www.wtatennis.com/tournaments/2020|archive-date=2022-09-20 |website=Women's Tennis Association |language=en}}</ref>
